concerns.text: The plan cites FR‑015 (dataset‑download script) as implemented, but the required `src/data/download_gsm8k.py` script is missing (see unresolved task T009). Without this script the GSM8K dataset cannot be reliably fetched and checksum‑validated, violating FR‑001/FR‑015.

Training TinyLlama‑1.1B (≈1 B parameters) for 3 epochs on a CPU‑only GitHub Actions runner, even with 8‑bit quantization, is unlikely to complete within the 6‑hour wall‑clock limit per CI job for a single seed. Running 30 seeds per condition (as required by FR‑001, FR‑006, etc.) would vastly exceed the free‑tier compute budget, making the experimental matrix infeasible under the stated resource constraints (FR‑007, FR‑012, Constitution VII).
